purpose: Exploratory policy sensitivity after the failed zero-extra-alert router screen; not a revised success claim or deployment choice
extra_false_alert_definition: Allowed additional false alerts per 10000 truly benign flows relative to each base; illustrative, not approved operational tolerances
automatic_selection: Same frozen score family and whole-tie 0.1 percentage-point calibration grid; maximize calibration macro-F1 under budget and base_false_alerts + floor(benign_count * extra_basis_points / 10000); equal scores prefer fewer calls
review_selection: Largest calibration whole-score group within quota, without label-based threshold selection; no automatic relabelling and no assumed successful human review
comparison: Freeze all new thresholds before rescoring the already-seen internal audit; use every paired seed and no audit-time quota trimming or operating-point selection
zero_slack_bridge: Every previous guarded calibration choice and internal-audit result must reproduce exactly
scope: Post-audit exploratory sensitivity on reused validation, not independent confirmation
